page.content:
Lady of the greenwood, added from May-game and later romance.

How Maid Marian connects

  • Artist: Robin of Sherwood — Marian is Robin's partner in the later greenwood household.
  • Faction: Merry Men — Marian becomes lady of the greenwood fellowship.

What is Maid Marian?

Maid Marian is scarce in the earliest ballads and enters from May festivals and play-texts. She becomes Robin's beloved and, in some tellings, a courtly exile in Sherwood.

Key threads lead to Robin of Sherwood and Merry Men.
